Base Notes: Musk, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Cypriol (Nagarmotha)

Experience the bold allure of Midnight Fire Perfume (100 ML), an exciting blend of juicy Mango, zesty Lemon, spicy Ginger, and sweet Red Berries. 9089323532378.title: Milan Frost Perfume (100-ML)
9089323532378.description:
Top Notes: Frozen Apple, Italian Bergamot, Italian Lemon, Star Anise
Middle Notes: Plum, Orange Blossom, Iced Marine Accord, Ceylon Cardamom
Base Notes: Crystal Moss, Driftwood, Amber, Musk

Milan Frost captures the crisp energy of a cool, modern escape. It opens with the fresh bite of frozen apple, Italian bergamot and lemon, sharpened by a subtle touch of star anise. At the heart, juicy plum and orange blossom blend with an iced marine accord and aromatic Ceylon cardamom, creating a fresh yet distinctive character. Crystal moss, driftwood, amber and musk settle into the base, leaving a clean, smooth and confidently masculine trail. Fresh, refined and effortlessly versatile, Milan Frost is made for the man who prefers his fragrance cool, polished and memorable.

7986438439002.title: Milano Wave Perfume (100-ML)

Top Notes: Lime, Lemon, Bergamot, Jasmine, Orange, Mandarin Orange, Neroli
Middle Notes: Sea Notes, Jasmine, Calone, Rosemary, Peach, Freesia, Hiacynth, Cyclamen, Violet, Coriander, Rose, Nutmeg, Mignonette
Base Notes: White Musk, Cedar, Oakmoss, Patchouli, Amber

Milano Wave Perfume captures the essence of the Mediterranean breeze with a vibrant and refreshing aroma. The fragrance opens with sparkling top notes of lime, lemon, bergamot, jasmine, orange, mandarin orange, and neroli an invigorating burst of citrus and florals. At its heart, sea notes blend beautifully with jasmine, rosemary, peach, freesia, and hyacinth, evoking the calm rhythm of ocean waves. The base settles into a smooth, lasting trail of white musk, cedar, oakmoss, patchouli, and amber, creating a sophisticated balance of freshness and warmth. Perfect for those who seek an energetic yet elegant everyday scent.
